# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

Confirmed the branch already contains the approved shrimp molt/reproduction fixes, so this apply-fixes pass was validation-only and required no additional source edits. I rechecked the relevant shrimp runtime and preset changes, then reran the focused reproduction and molt/mineral regressions plus the full `tank_core`, `tank_data`, and `tank_scenarios` suites; all passed on the current branch.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Inspected the current shrimp runtime and preset changes implicated by the approved review findings to confirm the branch already carried the requested fixes before editing anything.
2. [Completed] Reran the focused shrimp regression suites covering reproduction-factor behavior and mineral-gated molting to verify the reviewed paths still pass without further changes.
3. [Completed] Ran the full `tank_core` suite plus downstream `tank_data` and `tank_scenarios` tests to confirm broader stability and recorded this stage as validation-only because no new edits were needed.
